providers.title: Weak compactness in reflexive spaces
providers.scope: In a reflexive Banach space every closed bounded convex set is weakly compact.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reduction to a minimal invariant set
providers.scope: A counterexample yields a separable weakly compact convex K of diameter 1, minimal for a fixed-point-free nonexpansive T, with metrizable weak topology and weakly compact unit ball of the closed span of K - K.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Diametral approximate fixed points (Goebel, Karlovitz)
providers.scope: Every approximate fixed point sequence in a minimal set K has distance tending to 1 from every point of K.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kirk's theorem
providers.scope: In a reflexive space, every nonexpansive self-map of a closed bounded convex set with normal structure has a fixed point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Compact detector
providers.scope: For compact E in K and eps > 0, every sufficiently good approximate fixed point y has one functional of norm at most 1 with f(y - z) >= 1 - eps for all z in E.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Resolvents
providers.scope: R_n(a) = a/n + (1 - 1/n) T R_n(a) defines a nonexpansive R_n with ||T R_n a - R_n a|| <= 1/n and ||R_n a - a|| <= (n - 1)||Ta - a||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Idempotents in compact semigroups (Ellis)
providers.scope: A nonempty compact Hausdorff semigroup with continuous right translations contains an idempotent.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The anchor point
providers.scope: The intersection of the pointwise weak closures of the convex hulls of the tail families is a compact semigroup with an idempotent P; a fixed point x of P lies in the closed convex hull of the weak cluster set of its tail images.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Adaptive selection
providers.scope: Maps G_i chosen one at a time from tail families with adaptively prescribed precision admit, after finitely many steps, a convex combination of the G_i(x) within any given tau of x.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Evaluation on an ordered tree
providers.scope: Path weights sum to 1 on each level and to W_v on each block; the root output is W-weighted Lipschitz in the outputs prescribed on a level.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Compact families of predictions
providers.scope: The weak ultrafilter limits Z_v(theta) of the predicted root outputs are norm Lipschitz in theta, so E_v is norm compact and known before v is chosen.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The tree
providers.scope: An infinite ordered tree with summable budgets e_v, child averages within tau_k of x, ancestor displacements at most e_v, and functionals with f_v(y_v - z) >= 1 - e_v on E_v.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ideal cutoffs
providers.scope: The root output of the ideal cutoff state below v equals the prediction Q_v(b; theta^v).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Detecting a block
providers.scope: When the leaves below v switch to a common point b, the root output moves by U_v - V_v with f_v(U_v - V_v) >= W_v - 5 e_v.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A finite witness
providers.scope: At every depth some leaf s and some d in the unit ball of Y have f_v(d) >= 1/2 for all nonroot v on the path to s.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kirk's problem (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every nonexpansive self-map of a nonempty closed bounded convex subset of a real reflexive Banach space has a fixed point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The fixed point property of reflexive spaces
providers.scope: Every reflexive Banach space has the fixed point property for nonexpansive maps; equivalently for weakly compact convex domains.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
